title: Glance, Scrutinize, and Think: Advancing Video Anomaly Detection from Training-Free to Agentic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.11260v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to identify anomalous events and localize their temporal intervals. Existing approaches exhibit a "when-what" dissociation: traditional DNN-based methods localize when anomalies occur but lack semantic understanding, whereas LLM-based methods explain what happens but neglect precise temporal grounding. We attribute this to the absence of a unified reasoning paradigm. Inspired by how humans inspect surveillance videos - glancing globally to form temporal hypotheses, scrutinizing suspicious segments, and thinking iteratively to correct errors - we study this global-to-local paradigm from two perspectives. We first propose Glance then Scrutinize (GtS), a training-free framework using static and dynamic textual guidance for coarse-to-fine anomaly grounding and understanding, balancing accuracy and speed. To break the ceiling imposed by frozen external modules, we further propose a tool-augmented agentic VAD

translated_title: 浏览、细察与思考：从无训练到智能体推理的视频异常检测进展
translated_abstract: 视频异常检测（VAD）旨在识别异常事件并定位其时间区间。现有方法表现出“何时-何因”分离的现象：传统的基于深度神经网络的方法能够定位异常发生的时间，但缺乏语义理解；而基于大语言模型的方法能解释发生了什么，却忽视了精确的时间定位。我们将此归因于缺乏统一的推理范式。受人类检查监控视频方式的启发——先全局浏览以形成时间假设，再细察可疑片段，并迭代思考以纠正错误——我们从两个角度研究这种全局到局部的范式。首先，我们提出了“先浏览后细察”（GtS）框架，这是一个无需训练的框架，利用静态和动态文本指导进行从粗到细的异常定位和理解，平衡了准确性和速度。为了突破外部冻结模块带来的性能上限，我们进一步提出了一种工具增强的智能体化VAD方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种从无训练到智能体推理的视频异常检测新范式，通过全局浏览、局部细察和迭代思考的推理机制，解决了现有方法中时间定位与语义理解分离的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel paradigm for video anomaly detection from training-free to agentic reasoning, addressing the dissociation between temporal localization and semantic understanding through a global-to-local reasoning mechanism of glancing, scrutinizing, and iterative thinking.
